faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I find a tutor?
faq.a1: Use our search page to filter by subject, class, area, and budget. You can compare tutors side-by-side and message them directly.
faq.a2: Yes. Every tutor undergoes NID and degree verification before their profile is published on our platform.
faq.a3: Payments are made directly to the tutor. We support bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and bank transfers. Admin verification ensures security.
faq.a4: Yes. You can cancel your connection with a tutor at any time and find a new one. There are no lock-in contracts.
faq.q5: Is there a fee to join?
faq.a5: No. Joining eTuitionBD is completely free for students and parents. Tutors pay a small commission only after successful sessions.
